name: Pyrilutamide (KX-826)
description: Investigational androgen receptor blocker, put on the scalp as a solution (tincture)

status.studiedFor: Male and female pattern hair loss

note.text: Seven KX-826 trials are registered. None has posted results, and no journal paper reporting their results was found.

bullets: **Androgen receptor blocker** applied to the scalp
**Aims** to block the receptor without lowering hormones in the body (2026 review)
**Used as a comparator** in mouse studies of newer receptor blockers
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.pharmacokinetics: Measured in Phase 1 trials; no results posted
practical.soldAs: Investigational; not available as an approved drug in the US
practical.monitored: Target-area hair count, skin irritation, ECG, drug levels
practical.sport: Not named on the 2026 list; class S0 wording may cover it

regulatory.text: Not approved; no product in FDA's database
Not named; S0 may apply (no ruling)

references: ClinicalTrials.gov, KX-826 Phase 3 in Chinese men (NCT06126965), accessed Nov 2026
Burshtein et al., Front Pharmacol (review), Mar 2026
